note: Which of the site's script files make up the GifOS core (in the order a host loads them), and which the browser media port. Everything else the meeting page loads is the view's. The files stay where the site serves them. "apps": what a host with no screen loads after the core: the app runtime, to take part in apps through their data (no app frame), and the subscription (js/meet-subs.js: the meeting tickets and the capture a seat holds by a subscription or a pass, with none of its cards; a browser page loads it beside its own view, and js/core/view/subs.js, its cards, right after it). "nodeMedia": the Node media port a host with no browser runs when it has a codec: "host" in the host's own realm (ports/webaudio.js, the AudioContext over Opus), "plane" in the participant's (media/plane-node.js), "video" the picture port beside it (ports/vp8.js: the packer's surface over I420 and the VP8 codec). "viewLib": the shared view library a surface page loads before its own view part (js/core/view/kit.js: the view contract with the core, readings of its answers, the browser's own video controls). "pages": each surface page and its own view files, after the core, the media plane and "viewLib": meet.html and cast.html (the meeting's view part and the page's surface), run.html (the app runtime's audio-only view, with the "apps" runtime), embed.html (the broadcast player).
